headline: Retire?
caption:
Charles Oliveira says Justin Gaethje has a retirement decision to make.
Oliveira or Gaethje? 👇

The BMF champ says Gaethje won't top his White House payday and should decide if he's done. Oliveira faces Diego Lopes at UFC 335 on Dec 12 and says a win makes him the No. 1 lightweight contender.

Should Gaethje hang them up?
question: Oliveira or Gaethje?
